rationale: SAN006 (Trade Based Sanctions Evasion) is the preferred family for an advisory framed as a sanctions enforcement settlement, per its twin declaration naming TBML010 and stating the sanctions twin is preferred when framed that way. Page 1 describes Pegasus, a freight forwarder, dealing in blocked property by facilitating the importation of a machine supplied by a designated (sanctioned) company -- a trade transaction used as the instrument to move goods from a designated party, matching SAN006's 'trading party owned by/linked to a designated party' indicator. Single settlement narrative, not a developed multi-step technique, so medium confidence.

emergent_label: Non-cooperation with regulator subpoena / recordkeeping failure
rationale: Page 1 states Pegasus 'failed to respond fully for six months to an OFAC subpoena,' resulting in six apparent violations of the Reporting, Procedures and Penalties Regulations. No existing typology in the library (search floor 0.25, closest CM004 at 0.16) covers obstruction of a sanctions-regulator subpoena/reporting failure as a standalone mechanism, so this is proposed as emergent at low confidence given it is a single compliance-failure fact rather than a developed technique.
